items.headline: The Rings of Power renewed for Season 4
items.summary: Amazon has renewed The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power for a fourth season.

items.headline: ‘I See Buildings Fall Like Lightning’ leads BIFA craft winners
items.summary: The British Independent Film Awards has announced winners in 10 craft categories for 2026.

items.headline: Brandon Aiyuk is set to meet with the Commanders
items.summary: Free-agent wide receiver Brandon Aiyuk is scheduled to meet with the Washington Commanders after his recent release from the San Francisco 49ers.

items.headline: Tidal will ban AI-generated music starting December 9
items.summary: Tidal will ban AI-generated music starting December 9. The company expects to remove about 29 million tracks from its service.

items.headline: Webb reveals clues in Cassiopeia A’s supernova remnant
items.summary: NASA’s James Webb Space Telescope has captured a detailed view of Cassiopeia A, a remnant left by a massive star’s explosion.

items.headline: Kevin de Bruyne returns to Manchester City after move to Napoli
items.summary: Kevin de Bruyne is returning to Manchester City after joining Napoli last summer.

items.headline: Nvidia restores Jensen Huang as CEO after 2 weeks
items.summary: Nvidia has restored Jensen Huang as its chief executive, just 2 weeks after he resigned.

items.headline: Apple renews Ted Lasso for Season 5
items.summary: Apple has renewed Ted Lasso for a fifth season on Apple TV. The series had appeared to be ending after Season 3, making the renewal a return for a show many viewers thought was finished.

items.headline: Gloucestershire to become Bristol Lions for T20 Blast
items.summary: Gloucestershire will compete as the Bristol Lions in the T20 Blast starting with the 2027 season.

items.headline: Hubble shows barred galaxy NGC 4394
items.summary: NASA and ESA’s Hubble Space Telescope has released a new view of NGC 4394, a bright galaxy with a distinct bar.

items.headline: India’s Cockroach movement leader says he was stopped from flying to UK
items.summary: Saurav Das, a leader of India’s youth-led Cockroach movement, says immigration officials stopped him from boarding a flight from Delhi to the UK.

items.headline: Uber, Nuro, and Lucid begin driverless robotaxi testing in the Bay Area
items.summary: Uber, Nuro, and Lucid have begun testing fully driverless robotaxis on public roads in the San Francisco Bay Area.

items.headline: Disney orders an Aquamarine series
items.summary: Disney has ordered a live-action series inspired by the 2006 film Aquamarine.

items.headline: Trump says he persuaded Nvidia’s board to reinstate Jensen Huang
items.summary: Jensen Huang returned as Nvidia’s CEO on Monday, after the company’s board changed its mind within days.

items.headline: U.S.-led group to host 2031 Women’s World Cup
items.summary: FIFA has confirmed a United States-led bid to host the 2031 Women’s World Cup.
